It reads the public pages (about 1–2 minutes) and builds a private preview: the business's own texts and pictures in every design, a check of security, sovereignty and visibility to AI, and a spec with a fixed price. tools.name: get_check_status
tools.description: How far a website check is (reading, sorting, designs, done) and the private link to open it.

tools.name: check_agent_readiness
tools.description: Free test of whether AI assistants can find a website, understand the business (structured data, contact, hours, services) and book or act on it. Returns a score out of 100 and the most important fixes. Public data only, nothing stored.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Free 30-minute video call slots with number7even (Riaan Kleynhans), weekdays, Berlin time, from tomorrow on. Read-only: it books nothing. To book, give the person the link from get_booking_link; they pick or confirm the time themselves.

tools.name: get_check_quote
tools.description: The fixed price and what it includes for a finished check (s-… from start_website_check, or i-… for a described idea): setup excl. tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: A link to the page where the person books a 30-minute call with number7even. Optionally pre-fills a time from check_availability and the check id, so the call starts from their configuration. The person confirms with their own email and consent; an assistant cannot book on their behalf.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_booking_link · Private data: start_website_check, get_check_status, check_agent_readiness · Public sink: get_booking_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_booking_link · Private data: start_website_check, get_check_status, check_agent_readiness · Public sink: get_booking_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
